en-US.promotionalText: Six Pali editions side by side, differences highlighted. Thanissaro and Sujato line by line. The Suttas' own definitions. Neural Pali voice. Offline.
en-US.description:
Search, read and listen to the Suttas and the Vinaya, the Pali Canon, in Pali line by line with translations.

SIX PALI EDITIONS IN ONE TAP
Mahāsaṅgīti, Mahāsaṅgīti 2005, Buddha Jayanti (Sri Lanka), Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana (Myanmar), Siam Rath (Thailand) and PTS side by side. Every differing word is highlighted and marked as a reading or a spelling.

TRANSLATIONS LINE BY LINE
All of Thanissaro Bhikkhu's English (1,416 suttas) and Bhikkhu Sujato's, aligned with the Pali. A. Ya. Syrkin's Russian, published with the rights holder's permission, and Dhamma.Gift's own Russian. 25 languages in all; compare translators side by side.

THE SUTTAS' OWN DEFINITIONS
Tap a Pali word: see how the Suttas and the Vinaya themselves define it, with every line where the definition stands, then DPD, PTS and Sanskrit dictionaries.

PALI VOICE
The whole Sutta and Vinaya read by a neural Pali voice with Pali pronunciation, plus English and Russian voices. Listen to the Pali, the translation or both, line by line.

STRUCTURED SEARCH
Every word form across the canon. Results come as sortable, filterable tables, grouped by text or by word. Regex for exact phrases, and search by meaning.

LEARN BY HEART
Memorize mode on any sutta: first-letter cues and phrase-by-phrase audio with repeats.

WORKS OFFLINE
Download the library once, then read, search and listen with no network.

Also: favorites, history and reading progress synced across devices without an account (or with Google or Apple), dark theme, pinch to resize text.
